candidate.exact_claim_tested: At modelcontextprotocol/rust-sdk commit 4a738b9dd99eaca418b614afa433a0cbdaf8d056, a successful discover lifecycle stores client request metadata and the generic client send path attaches protocolVersion, clientInfo and clientCapabilities to subsequent ordinary requests before transport send; the 2026-07-28 server inline lifecycle requires protocolVersion and clientCapabilities, with clientInfo optional, and rejects missing or malformed required metadata with INVALID_PARAMS. Legacy initialize/session paths may omit per-request metadata.

observations: discover_startup constructs the discover request with RequestMetaObject::with_client_context(candidate protocol version, clientInfo, clientCapabilities). On a successful DiscoverResult it selects a mutually supported version and stores ClientRequestMetadata containing selected protocol version, clientInfo and clientCapabilities on the Peer.

Peer::send_request_with_option_and_subscription reads stored ClientRequestMetadata and writes protocolVersion, clientInfo and clientCapabilities into the request metadata before optional caller metadata, progressToken insertion and the PeerSinkMessage::Request transport send.

RequestMetaObject::DRAFT_REQUIRED_KEYS contains exactly io.modelcontextprotocol/protocolVersion and io.modelcontextprotocol/clientCapabilities. clientInfo is documented and implemented as optional. missing_required_keys treats absent or type-malformed required values as missing for protocol versions >= 2026-07-28.

When the server's first non-Initialize request has valid 2026-07-28 request metadata, serve_server_with_ct_inner creates the Peer and calls require_request_metadata. ServerHandler::handle_request then requires metadata for later inline-lifecycle requests and returns invalid_params when either required key is absent or malformed.

The official 2026-07-28 MCP release describes the stateless lifecycle: initialize/initialized and protocol sessions are retired, per-request protocol/client context moves into _meta, and server/discover is available for capability discovery.

For direct peers, RoleClient::configure_direct_peer installs per-request client metadata only for server protocol >= 2026-07-28. The handler explicitly preserves the legacy initialize/session model where per-request metadata may be omitted.
